description: 5T OTA: the mirror pole at node x (PMOS Meyer C_gs3 + C_gs4 plus the overlap C_gd1, C_gd4) and its pole-zero doublet, the output pole (CL, C_gd2, C_gd4), and the C_gd feedthrough zeros. Gate capacitances only (the other corpus circuits cover the junctions), so the symbolic certificate stays small enough for Lean.
